display.title: {"text": "IV. Arcane Conservatory"}
description: &6STATION IV&r  Commission one research or ritual room - Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells or Occultism - and feed it an Ancient Core.
&eWhy:&r Expedition protection (the Ward of Passage) and the deep survey of boss lairs.
&eUnlocks:&r The Ward of Passage (resistance and fire safety for an expedition, once per day per member) and lair charts to boss arenas.
&7Commission it from the charter panel. This quest completes by itself when the station records it.&r
&aDo:&r Commission Arcane Conservatory at your charter.
&6You get:&r Foundry and Logistics: power, assembly and networked storage.
